commit_message: Close managed runtime repair and replay loop
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0131 first-release agent contracts
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0131 first-release completion by closing the bounded managed Play/frame/evaluate/repair loop. Runtime failures are repaired separately from source-validation failures, wait for managed Play to stop, reuse the same isolated workspace, rerun managed validation, and start a fresh Play/capture/evaluation cycle.

Provider-planned runtime inputs are retained as an ephemeral replay recipe across repair cycles and replaced only when a repair provider supplies a new recipe. Runtime repair is bounded to two autonomous attempts and does not alter persisted session schema or public authoring/runtime contracts.
